responsibility: Declares the common symbol base class for analyzer regions and svalues. It owns the per-object complexity metric and a stable numeric identifier, and exposes accessors plus an ID comparison helper so higher-level analyzer components can bound symbolic growth and produce deterministic ordering of abstract memory objects and symbolic values.
same_name_distinction: Declares the analyzer’s shared symbol base class and its stored metadata for regions and svalues; the companion symbol.cc is limited to the out-of-line ID-comparison implementation.
